answer_1.quote: We develop an algorithm for solving dictionary-based substitution codes. The algorithm uses a known-plaintext attack (exploiting small samples of decoded material), a neural language model, and beam search.

answer_2.quote: Table gives our results on per-word-token decipherment accuracy. Our method is able to recover 73.8% of the word tokens...

answer_4.quote: For tokens where our system output does not match the original plaintext, we asked an outside annotator to indicate whether our model captures the same meaning.
